caption:
Stock market news | NSE closed for Guru Nanak Jayanti on Nov 24

The National Stock Exchange (NSE) and Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) will pause trading on Tuesday, 24 November 2026 for the Guru Nanak Jayanti holiday. MCX will run only its evening session that day.
Investors should note the one-day break and plan orders accordingly, as normal market activity resumes on Wednesday, 25 November 2026.

Save this for later and send it to a friend who trades.

For information only. Not investment advice.
